dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Little Yu? Little Yuuu, where are you...?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Hmm, a snapped branch and some trampled grass... It looks like the girl was hiding here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guess that means we're on the right track. Let's keep going.
